en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide, unpaved street in a European small town. Two‑storey masonry houses with simple facades line both sides of the road; wooden fences and shuttered windows are visible. A church with a tall tower and spire stands at the end of the street in the background. Numerous children and a few adults in early‑20th‑century rural clothing gather and walk along the right side of the street, suggesting a lively village scene. Large leafy trees hang over the left side of the road.
